allowed_changes: use exact frozen SPLV, MTUM and SPY adjusted-close files
rebalance wrapper only at first common session of each calendar year
use same historical USD/CNY conversion for all legs
comparison_gates: Sharpe > SPY buy-and-hold on matched total-return/FX window
expected_outputs: Defensive Momentum, SPY buy-hold and cash CSVs
trade count, max gross, minimum cash and fingerprint
follow_up_policy: After formal performance is viewed, do not alter weights, factor membership or rebalance cadence in this lineage. A screening/dynamic allocation version is a separate strategy family, not rescue tuning.
forbidden_changes: adding trend, VIX, macro, volatility target or drawdown timing
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage or gross above 100%
hypothesis: Low-volatility and momentum are distinct long-only equity effects with complementary payoff profiles: low-volatility reduces market beta and downside concentration while momentum retains exposure to persistent winners. A fixed 50/50 annual allocation between SPLV and MTUM may preserve more equity return than bond-heavy defensive portfolios while lowering drawdown enough to improve risk-adjusted outcomes, with very low external turnover and no leverage.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: Applied Economics 2025 Combining low-volatility and momentum: explicitly evaluates 50/50 long-only combinations and reports stronger risk-adjusted performance than the market in its sample
Long-only factor literature finds practical implementation can be preferable after shorting costs/decay, and low-volatility/momentum remain investable factor premia
selection_metric: No weight, factor or cadence search. Exactly the literature-motivated 50/50 long-only SPLV+MTUM combination, annual wrapper rebalance. Component factors have been studied before, but this exact combined CNY/cost portfolio has not been viewed. Validation, objective and SPY comparison are separate ATM-SVP-3 axes.

shared_rules.rebalance: first common session each calendar year

swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_defensive_momentum_001.py -> frozen SPLV/MTUM/SPY adjusted-close total-return proxies + common USD/CNY -> BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace
